      "snippet": "Yes — this is the mechanism that gets you to “snap-of-the-fingers” navigation, because it changes the default behavior from:

“search the filesystem live” (slow, noisy, context-polluting)

to:

“consult a precomputed index + router” (fast, bounded, repeatable)

What you should expect in practice
If the index is present and up to date, then for questions like:

“Where is EVG defined?”

“Where is Sandcrawler fail-close enforced?”
